RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the February  13, 2009/Magha 24, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
1
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Sick small and medium
enterprises
†*1. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of MICRO, SMALL
AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at present
there are about 1.3 crore industrial units in
the country which are in small and medium
enterprises sector;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
this enterprises sector contributes about
40 per cent to the exports of the country;
and
(c) if not, the details of the actual
estimate and the number of units in this
sector which have become sick so far due
to international economic recession and the
amount proposed to be provided by banks
and other institutions to this sector to get
rid of this sickness?
Starvation in the country
†*2. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
International Food Policy Research
Institute has stated that 23 crore people
face starvation in India;
(b) last five years' official figures thereon
available with Government, State-wise
details thereof;
(c) whether this situation is likely to
further deteriorate in view of the current
economic scenario; and
(d) if so, the plan to tackle this problem?
Availability of fertilizers in the
country
*3. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has curbed

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
imports of fertilizers to keep fertilizer
subsidy within reasonable limits as the
international prices of fertilizers have gone
up by a factor of 2 to 3 times, resulting in a
steep increase in the quantum of fertilizer
subsidy;
(b) if so, whether this has resulted in a
shortage of fertilizers in the country and
led to violent agitation by farmers;
(c) whether fertilizer is being distributed
in some places from police stations; and
(d) what steps Government is taking to
ease farmers' problems in this regard?
Denial of treatment by CGHS
empanelled hospitals
*4. SHRI V ARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
multi-speciality hospitals in Delhi and
adjoining areas which had agreed to treat
C.G .H.S. card holders without payment
from beneficiaries at the time of treatment
and to recover it from Government, have
now discontinued that facility;
(b) if so, the names of the concerned
hospitals and the reasons for the
withdrawal of facility, thereby causing
hardship, particularly to pensioners; and
(c) the action proposed by Government
to restore the earlier arrangement?
Under-utilization of funds by
Himachal Pradesh
*5. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to refer
to answer to Unstarred Question 2114
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 19th
December, 2008 and to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Rs. 10.42
crore only has been utilized out of Rs. 71.03
crore allocated by Government for financial
year 2008-09 under National Rural Health
Mission (NRHM) by the Himachal Pradesh
Government;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether State Government of
Himachal Pradesh does not have any
planning to utilize the fund for achieving
the target of NRHM;
(d) if so, details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto; and
(e) whether Government has taken any
initiative to encourage such States which
are not implementing the scheme seriously
and do not come forward with good
scheme?
Conversion of wasteland into
cultivable land
†*6. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 17.45 per
cent of land is wasteland in the country;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard;
(c) the area of wasteland which has been
converted into agricultural land from 2006
to 2008; and
(d) the total area of wasteland targeted
to be converted into cultivable land during
the Eleventh Five Y ear Plan?
Closure of sugar mills
*7. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the price of

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
sugar has increased very fast during the
last 2-3 years due to closure of sugar mills;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government is taking in
this regard?
Shortage of fertilizers in Orissa
*8. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State of
Orissa has been facing acute shortage of
fertilizers and the State Government has
repeatedly written/reminded the Centre for
help in the matter;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of Union
Government to provide the much needed
fertilizers to the farmers of the State to
save their crops?
Qualification for membership of
Railway Board
†*9. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any fixed rule/qualifications
have been laid down for membership of
Railway Board;
(b) whether there is any resentment
among officers in this regard;
(c) whether it is causing delay in decision
making process; and
(d) the status thereof?
Hazardous effect of GM Food
*10. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
SHRIMA TI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a group of Scientists and
agriculture experts have cautioned against
introduction of genetically modified (GM)
food crops, especially BT Brinjal in the
country;
(b) if so, whether such GM food stuffs
may cause allergies and unknown health
problems;
(c) if so, whether several developed
countries have either banned or restricted
the entry of GM foods; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to restrict the entry of GM foods in
the country?
Third berth near window in train
coaches
†*11. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
W AL: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
had decided to add a third berth near the
window of a railway compartment in order
to increase its income;
(b) if so, the total number of coaches
where a third berth has been added under
the said scheme so far;
(c) to what extent the same has added
to the income of Railway Department so
far; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that now it
is being proposed to discontinue this
scheme?

4
Free second line HIV treatment
*12. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to provide
second line treatment to HIV patients free
of cost;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether certain hospitals have been
identified in the country for providing such
free treatment; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, inter-alia
indicating those that are located in Orissa
and Jharkhand?
Sale price of agricultural products
†*13. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many
committees have been set up in the country
during the last five years to make suggestion
for evolving a formula to fix the sale price
of agricultural products;
(b) if so, the name of these committees
and when they were set up and when they
submitted their recommendations to
Government;
(c) whether Government has made any
formulae for determining the sale prices on
the basis of recommendations of these
committees; and
(d) if so, the details of formulae and the
agricultural products for which support
price has been fixed so far on this basis?
Shortage of fertilizers
*14. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI NAND KISHORE Y ADA V:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) the allocation of fertilizers made to
various States during 2008-09;
(b) whether some States, particularly
Uttar Pradesh are facing shortage of
fertilizers; and
(c) if so, the action taken by Government
to meet the demand of urea and other
fertilizers to such States?
Allocation of foodgrains to
Uttarakhand
†*15. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that allocation of
foodgrains under Public Distribution
System to the State of Uttarakhand has
been reduced during the last two years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether the number of poor families
in the State of Uttarakhand is less than
national average and whether any scheme
is under consideration with Government
to allocate more foodgrains to such States
under the Public Distribution System?
Herbal cure for malaria
*16. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a plant named
Gonmostama found in the North Eastern
part of the country has been found to be an
effective cure against malaria;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

5
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether Government plans to
conduct further research on the
effectiveness of the plant for curing malaria;
and
(c) if so, the details in this regard?
Hike in sugar price
*17. SHRI VIJAY JAW AHARLAL
DARDA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether with no firmed up figure
available yet on the estimated shortfall in
sugarcane output this season and sugar
prices shooting up, Ministry is moving to
seek permission of Government of
importing raw-sugar;
(b) if so, whether Ministry plans to
take permission to allow mills to import
raw sugar;
(c) whether the duty is expected to fall
due to low acreage of the crop followed by
erratic weather conditions especially in
Maharashtra, Karnataka and parts of U.P.;
(d) whether prices have already risen
in retail markets to Rs. 21 per kg. from Rs.
17 per kg. corresponding last year; and
(e) if so, whether any final decision has
been taken?
Delayed railway projects
*18. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of ongoing works and
projects of railways in the country which
have not been completed on their original
scheduled time and have been delayed;
(b) the reasons therefor in each case;
(c) the remedial measures taken; and
(d) by when those works would be
completed?
Price control of drugs
†*19. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that all medicines
manufactured from 72 basic medicines
prescribed under the Drug Price Control
Order, 1995 come under the purview of
price control;
(b) whether it is also a fact that some
companies are overcharging for three
hundred twelve drug formulae that come
under the purview of price control in the
market;
(c) if so, since when these drug
manufacturing companies are overcharging
the price of drugs and the excess amount
charged by them from the public so far;
(d) whether National Drugs Pricing
Authority (NPPA) has ordered for
recovery from these drug manufacturing
companies; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Decrease in the agricultural land
†*20. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during last
few years there has been a decrease in the
land under cultivation in the country due
to use of agricultural land for other
purposes;

6
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 7th February, 2009 Secretary-General.
Magha 18, 1930 (Saka)
(b) if so, yearly average of reduction in
agricultural land from 2004 to 2008; and
(c) the names of States and the quantum
of reduction area in each of them?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Agriculture :  2, 6, 10, 13, 20,
Chemicals and Fertilizers : 3, 8, 14, 19,
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public
Distribution : 7, 15, 17,
Health and Family Welfare : 4, 5, 12, 16,
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises :1 ,
Railways : 9, 11, 18.
Steel :—
GMGIPMRND—364RS—07.02.2009.
